title: Interactive Design by Integrating a Large Pre-Trained Language Model and Building Information Modeling
task: 自然语言交互式BIM设计细化与修改
inputData: BIM模型 + 自然语言设计意图；BIM通过BIM2XML转换为结构化XML供LLM解析与修改
contribution: 提出BIM2XML–NADIA–XML2BIM交互式设计流程，将BIM模型转换为结构化XML，由GPT系列识别设计者意图、相关对象与属性并生成修改后的XML，再回写Revit，实现自然语言驱动的BIM设计细化。
abstract: This study integrates OpenAI GPT-series language models with BIM as an interactive architectural design assistant. BIM2XML converts a BIM model into XML, the natural-language architectural detailing component interprets designer intent and refines objects and attributes in that structured representation, and XML2BIM converts the modified XML back into the BIM environment. The approach was validated through a Revit design-detailing case study.
journal: Computing in Civil Engineering 2023: Visualization, Information Modeling, and Simulation (ASCE)
methodology: The workflow contains three implemented components. BIM2XML serializes selected BIM information into XML. The LLM-based NADIA component receives the structured model context and natural-language design request, identifies the intended design action, target object and attributes, and returns a revised XML representation. XML2BIM parses the generated XML and applies the resulting design changes back to Revit. The published conference paper validates the end-to-end loop on an architectural design-detailing case.
results: The Revit case study demonstrates that GPT-series models can interpret natural-language design intent and produce structured BIM modifications that are converted back into the authoring environment. The study is primarily a feasibility demonstration rather than a large quantitative benchmark; it also compares generations from GPT-3, GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 to examine consistency in design-detailing responses.
taskEn: Interactive BIM design detailing and modification from natural language
inputDataEn: BIM models plus natural-language design intent; BIM content is serialized as structured XML for LLM interpretation and modification
operationEvidence: The LLM generates revised structured XML describing BIM object/attribute changes, and XML2BIM executes those changes in Revit.
